metrics.definition: Power BI measure 00 Average_Days_Outstanding_by_PO on fact_project_billing_current_v.
metrics.daxExpression:
AVERAGEX(
    'fact_project_billing_current_v',
    VAR INVDateFilter = 
        CALCULATE(
            MAX('fact_project_billing_current_v'[invoice_date]), 
            'fact_project_billing_current_v'[gross_amount] > 0,
            NOT(ISBLANK(fact_project_billing_current_v[paid_date])),
            'fact_project_billing_current_v'[export_date] = MAX('fact_project_billing_current_v'[export_date])
        )
    
    VAR LatestPaidDate = 
        CALCULATE(
            MAX('fact_project_billing_current_v'[paid_date]),
            NOT(ISBLANK(fact_project_billing_current_v[paid_date])),
            'fact_project_billing_current_v'[gross_amount] > 0
        )

    VAR IsPaid = NOT(ISBLANK(LatestPaidDate))

    VAR DateDiff = 
        IF(
            IsPaid,
            DATEDIFF(INVDateFilter, LatestPaidDate, DAY),
            DATEDIFF(INVDateFilter, TODAY(), DAY)
        )

    RETURN DateDiff
)

metrics.definition: Power BI measure Arrow_Date on Project Grades.
metrics.daxExpression:
VAR DateCount =
    CALCULATE (
        DISTINCTCOUNT ( 'Trending Data'[Month] ),
        ALL ( 'Trending Data'[Month] )
    )

VAR LatestDate =
    CALCULATE (
        MAX ( 'Trending Data'[Month] ),
        ALL ( 'Trending Data'[Month] )
    )

VAR SecondLatestDate =
    MAXX (
        TOPN (
            1,
            FILTER (
                ALL ( 'Trending Data'[Month] ),
                'Trending Data'[Month] < LatestDate
            ),
            'Trending Data'[Month], DESC
        ),
        'Trending Data'[Month]
    )

RETURN
    IF (
        DateCount = 1,
        LatestDate,
        IF (
            LatestDate >= TODAY () - 7,
            SecondLatestDate,
            LatestDate
        )
    )

VAR Value1 = [COST PERC COMP Value]
VAR Value2 = [BILLINGS PERC COMP Value]
VAR Value3 = [MARGIN GAIN/FADE Value]
VAR Value4 = [CASHFLOW Value]
VAR Value5 = [AGED RECEIVABLES DAYS Value]
VAR Value6 = [BILLINGS SPREAD Value]
VAR Value7 = [HOURS W/O QTY Value]
VAR Value8 = [CHANGE RISK Value]
VAR Value9 = [PROCUREMENT PERC COMP Value]
VAR Value10 = [RECONCILIATION Value]
VAR Value11 = [PROFORMA REVENUE Value]
VAR Value12 = [PROFORMA MARGIN Value]
VAR Value13 = [UNDER BILLED Value]
VAR Value14 = [SP PF Value]

VAR Score_FIN =
    IF(Value1 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_CostPercComp]), 0) +
    IF(Value2 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_BillingPercComp]), 0) +
    IF(Value3 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_MarginGainLoss]), 0) +
    IF(Value4 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_CashflowPosition]), 0) +
    IF(Value5 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_ARDays]), 0) +
    IF(Value6 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_BillingSpread]), 0) +
    IF(Value7 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_QTYvsHR]), 0) +
    IF(Value8 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_ChangeRisk]), 0) +
    IF(Value9 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_Procurement]), 0) +
    IF(Value10 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_Recon]), 0) +
    IF(Value11 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_ProRev]), 0) +
    IF(Value12 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_ProMar]), 0) +
    IF(Value13 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_UnderBilledPosition]), 0) +
    IF(Value14 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[FIN_SelfPerformPF]), 0)

// ===== QDR Section =====
VAR Include1 = [COST PER REV Value]
VAR Include2 = [COST PER DEF Value]
VAR Include3 = [ITP Value]
VAR Include4 = [SUNDT COST PER MHR Value]

VAR Score_QDR =
    IF(Include1 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[QDR_Cost_per_Rev]), 0) +
    IF(Include2 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[QDR_CostperDef]), 0) +
    IF(Include3 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[QDR_ITPs]), 0) +
    IF(Include4 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[QDR_SundtCostperMHR]), 0)

VAR Include_Energy = [ENERGY INDEX Value]
VAR Include_PSLI = [PSLI SCORE Value]
VAR Include_STCKY_Success = [STCKY SUCCESS RATE Value]

    IF(Include_CVIS = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[Safety_CVIS_WALKS]), 0) +
    IF(Include_Energy = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[Safety_Energy]), 0) +
    IF(Include_PSLI = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[Safety_PSLI]), 0) +
    IF(Include_STCKY_Success = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[Safety_STCKY_Success_Rate]), 0) +
    IF(Include_STCKY_Walks = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[Safety_STCKY_WALKS]), 0)

// ===== Schedule Section =====

VAR SCH2 = [SUBSTANTIAL COMPLETION Value]
VAR SCH3 = [FLOAT TREND Value]
VAR SCH4 = [PLANNED VS ACTUALS START Value]
VAR SCH5 = [SPI Value]
VAR SCH6 = [BASELINE VS PLANNED EAC Value]
VAR SCH7 = [PLANNED VS ACTUALS END Value]

    IF(SCH1 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[SCH_PercComp]), 0) +
    IF(SCH2 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[SCH_SCOMP_Total_Float]), 0) +
    IF(SCH3 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[SCH_MIN_Float_Trend]), 0) +
    IF(SCH4 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[SCH_PvsAStart]), 0) +
    IF(SCH5 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[SCH_SPI]), 0) +
    IF(SCH6 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[SCH_BPEAC]), 0) +
    IF(SCH7 = 1, AVERAGE('Project Grades'[SCH_PvsAEnd]), 0)

RETURN
    Score_FIN + Score_QDR + Score_Safety + Score_SCH
